There are 7 types of map locations in Slay the Spire:

|-

!Description
!Info

|[[Unknown Location]]
[[File:Unknown1.jpg|thumb|center]]
|[[File:Unknown_Room.jpg|thumb|center]]
|Often contains an [[Events|event]], but may also contain a non-[[Elite]] enemy encounter, [[Treasure Room]], or [[Shop]].

The likelihoods of these options are changed by {{R|Juzu Bracelet}} and {{R|Tiny Chest}}.
|-
|[[Shop]] [[File:Shop1.jpg|thumb|center]]
|[[File:Shop.jpg|thumb|center]]
|Buy cards, relics, potions, and/or remove a card from your deck, at the cost of some [[Gold]].
|-
|[[Treasure Room]] [[File:Chest1.jpg|thumb|center]]
|[[File:Chest.jpg|thumb|center]]
|1 random [[Relics|Relic]] and potentially [[Gold]].

Affected by {{R|N'loth's Hungry Face}}, {{R|Cursed Key}}, and {{R|Matryoshka}}.
|-
|[[Rest Site]] [[File:Rest1.jpg|thumb|center]]
|[[File:Rest.jpg|thumb|center]]
|Rest (heal HP) or Smith ([[upgrade]] a card).

{{R|Shovel}}, {{R|Girya}}, and {{R|Peace Pipe}} add additional options.
|-
|[[File:Enemy1.jpg|thumb|center]]
|[[File:Enemy.jpg|thumb|center]]
|Basic [[Monsters|monster]] fights (non-[[Elites]]).
|-
|[[File:Elite1.jpg|thumb|center]]
|[[File:Elite.jpg|thumb|center]]
|Fight an [[Elites|Elite]] monster, gaining a [[Relics|relic]] as a reward in addition to normal bonuses.

(With the {{R|Black Star}} you gain 2 relics.)

An animated flame behind the [[Elite]] represents a [[Elites#Elite Buffs|buffed Elite]] that holds the [[Keys#Emerald Key|Emerald Key]] for [[Act 4]]. (This only shows up once you have completed [[Act 3]] with all characters.)
|-
|[[File:Boss.jpg|thumb|center]]
|'''Boss Fight'''
|The end of each map leads to a [[Bosses|boss]]. The reward is a choice of 1 of 3 [[Rare Cards]] and a choice of 1 of 3 [[Relics#Boss|Boss Relics]].
|}
